notes.title: v1.0.2.11 released!
notes.content:
[h1]v1.0.2.11 released! [/h1] 

This is a maintenance release.

[list]
[*] [b]Samplerate change[/b]
[list]
[*]You can now change the samplerate from the Audio/MIDI settings tab
[*]This will restart the app automatically when changed
[/list]

[*] [b]Features and fixes[/b]
[list]
[*]Haptics added for WMR devices
[*]Auto Screenshot taker. Click the screenshot button in the environment menu, after 5 Seconds, several screenshots will be taken in Steam
[*]Bloom now defaults to on
[*]Teleport UI made more subtle
[*]Fixed clipping issues in multiplayer audio when overloaded
[*]Fixed hand controls not being displayed outside the main area
[*]Fixed intermittent gating of multiplayer voice
[/list]
[/list]

notes.title: Social VR and Spatial Mixing comes to AliveInVR!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30014587/721ad9e05399b47b74f4fcc116f0992375bb9a54.png[/img]

[h1]You can now collaborate or spectate with multiplayer sessions![/h1]
[list]
[*] [b]Social/Multiplayer[/b]
[list]
[*]Choose Social in the menu. Make sure you route audio through the AliveInVR ASIO driver in Ableton.[url=https://youtu.be/wZywqvr0pMM]See tutorial[/url]
[*]Hosting a Session gets your audio and Ableton Session control shared to all players. 
[*]Finding and joining a Session lets you collaborate or spectate on someone else's Session ( whoever hosted the multiplayer session)
[*] Voice chat in VR with full avatar control
[*] Voice waveforms appear above the head of each player
[*] Mute or hide other players, this only affects your view of the player
[*] A high quality audio feed is used to send music to all players. Lower quality is used for voice chat.
[*] The owner of the session can change the scene/time of day and this will apply to all players.
[*] Non realtime controls such as triggering clips and scenes or editing the step sequencer can be controlled by anyone. Realtime controls such as drumracks and instruments work for the host of the session only. A latency will occur if clients (non-hosts) trigger drums or instruments.
[*] When in a multiplayer Session, go back to the Social menu and you can send invites to friends on Steam.
[/list]

[*] [b]Spatial mixing[/b]
[list]
[*]Turn on Spatial Audio in the Audio/MIDI menu.
[*]Make sure you route audio through the AliveInVR ASIO driver in Ableton.[url=https://youtu.be/wZywqvr0pMM]See tutorial[/url]
[*]Each clip playing will generate audio spatially based on it's position
[*]Waveforms are displayed when clips are playing
[*]Three waveform types can be chosen in settings (or turn off waveforms)
[*]When playing instruments or drum racks, the waveform for the entire track will be displayed in the triggered block and be spatialised from the triggered block.
[*]If all channels are mono in the Ableton Session, full spatialisation is applied (binaural). If channels are stereo in Ableton, panning and proximity is applied.
[*]Waveforms are not sent to client players in multiplayer due to bandwidth limitations.
[/list]


[*] [b]Features and fixes[/b]
[list]
[*]New tabbed menu system
[*]In game mirror/camera preview is now optional in the menu
[*]Much better GPU performance when in game cameras and mirrors turned off +100%
[*]Improved avatar animation and control
[*]2 New Avatars
[*]New foggy scifi scene - stand behind the blocks to see shadowed fog effects
[*]Run without VR if no headset is connected. This is experimental and has no interaction with blocks but you can spectate a session. Hit Esc to get to the menu system. Use WASD controls to navigate.
[*]Added help
[*]Better bounding on the indoors scene, you can no longer teleport outside
[*]When the camera is turned off a single eye view is shown on the desktop mirror. When the camera is on, a smoothed headcam is mirrored on the desktop unless 'show the camera output on the desktop' is enabled in the menu. 
[/list]


[/list]

notes.title: New release - New, Duplicate, Fixed Length Record, Automation Record, Session Record, Undo, Redo!
notes.content:
[h1] Latest Release - New, Duplicate, Fixed Length Record, Automation Record, Session Record, Undo, Redo [/h1] 

[list]
[*] [b]Extended Transport controls [/b]  - Added Push style session recording workflow.
[list]
[*] Session record, New and Duplicate to create clips and loop record.
[*] Includes Fixed/Unfixed length recording mode, Automation record on and off.
[/list]

[*] [b]Smooth first person desktop mirror [/b]  - If the camera is turned on and mirror to desktop is off, the first person camera is now a smoothed follower camera.

[*] [b]Minor bugfixes[/b]
[list]
[*]Fixed teleport destination near blocks which was inconsistent in the previous release. 
[*]Hitting blocks and controls is now more accurate.
[*]Pulling a block out of the wall and letting go close to the wall no longer sucks the block back into the wall.
[*]When loop recording, notes colour the entire block red, previously the block was framed red.
[/list]

[/list]

There will now be a pause of about a month in feature releases (they have been mostly weekly up to now). Bugfix/stability releases will be made if needed.
This is to make space for the next phase of development/test.

Come and see AliveInVR at the WeAreRobots show in November!

notes.title: 0.0.0.27 Released - Save and load layouts, minor bug fixes.
notes.content:
[list]
[*] [b]Save and load layouts [/b]  - access 8 slots to save and load layouts
[list]
[*]Layouts are stored and restored per mode (Session, Note and Mixer).
[*]The current state is saved on exit and restored on load - so it always comes back the way it was last time.
[*]The reset button also operates per mode so hitting reset in session mode clears the session mode layout only, hitting reset in note mode clears that only etc.
[*] Saving and loading a layout slot restores all modes - Session, Note and Mixer.
[/list]

[*] [b]Menu system [/b]  - Curved UI, added save and load slots on the right, improved text clarity. 
Blocks are hidden when the menu is opened. On loading a layout the blocks are displayed for 2 seconds.

[*] [b]Interaction improvements [/b]
[list]
[*]Grab blocks without touching them (grab close to them) and they can be moved without triggering.
[*]Hold a block and you can trigger it with the other hand.
[*]Scale options are displayed on the blocks when touching 'Scale' in note mode.
[/list]

[*] [b]Minor bugfixes[/b]
[list]
[*]Blocks can now trigger when the hand controls are visible whilst hitting the block.
[*]Fixed - some Visual FX could get stuck on in Eye Candy mode.
[*]When using the XYZ control, Visual FX are no longer applied to the triggered block (There was too much going on at once).
[*]When XYZ controlling pitch bend, pitch bend is now reset on letting go of the grip button, not after the sphere has closed.
[*]Boundaries in the indoor scene now work consistently.
[/list]

notes.title: 0.0.0.26 Released - 3D XYZ controllers, indoor scene!
notes.content:
[h1] 0.0.0.26 Released [/h1] 

It's the weekend again, time for some more new features!

[list]
[*] [b]XYZ 3D controllers [/b]  - map them in the menu. use the grip control and then move your hand in the sphere to send XYZ controls.
[list]
[*]Macros control the currently selected instrument's macros in note mode, or audio device macros in audio device mode.
[*]Standard CC controllers control whatever is globally mapped in Ableton regardless of track selection.
[*]Pitch bend controls the currently selected instrument.
[/list]

[*] [b]Indoor environment [/b]  - Choose the house icon from the menu to toggle between indoors and outdoors.

[*] [b]Desktop mirror [/b]  - Show the camera output on the desktop mirror - selectable from the menu, the first person view is displayed picture in picture.

[*] [b]Menu system cleanup [/b]  - There's more stuff so it needed a tidy! Walking mode renamed to smooth locomotion.

[*] [b]Minor bugfixes and changes [/b]
[list]
[*]Moved track names to the top of tracks to be easier to read
[*]Lazer pointers are now orange to contrast with the menus and controls better
[*]This uses a later Oculus SDK. This means supersampling is now set from 0.5 to 2.0 on Oculus Rift only.
[*]Reflections on helmet and hands now update based on the daylight setting.
[/list]

notes.title: 0.0.0.23 Released - Eye candy mode, Leap Motion and KB Shortcuts!
notes.content:
[h1] 0.0.0.23 Released [/h1] 

It's the weekend, time for some new features!

[list]
[*] [b]Eye candy mode [/b]  - turn it on in the menu. Note mode creates smoke signals that turn into stars, feel the force when playing instrument notes, see your drum patterns merge with the sky - and a few birds and butterflies.

[*] [b]More track name displays [/b]  - See the current track name when using instruments and drum racks. Track names are shown under mixer tracks and above the track left and track right controls.

[*] [b]Keyboard shortcuts for demoing [/b]  - Ctrl + left/right/up/down arrow for scene and track navigation. 
Ctrl + D for day/night modes, Ctrl + Space for re-centering the player. Ctrl + Enter for general reset. Ctrl + W to toggle walking mode. Ctrl + N for clip names, Ctrl + E for Eye candy mode.

[*] [b]Blocks fill in note mode when playing [/b]  - It's much clearer which notes are triggering in Note mode.

[*] [b]Leap motion [/b]  - Experimental Leap motion support. Use pinch with your index finger and thumb to grab items. Use left hand fist forwards and backwards to walk (pretend you're riding a horse!).

notes.title: 0.0.0.21 Released - Controls on your hands!
notes.content:
[h1] Latest release now live [/h1] 

 [list]
    [*]Controls on hand - Display Session, Note controls etc.. on the back of your hand.
    [*]Steadycam - Moving the camera and mirror is now springy for smooth filming. 
    [*]Fixed a bug where the mixer page would not display properly when a track name has an unusual character in it.
[/list]

To enable controls on your hands, turn it on in the menu as 'Controls on hand'. 

When you look at the back of your hand (like you would a wrist watch), you can access the main controls using the trigger of the other hand. No longer any need to carry the controls around with you. In this mode the controls in the world will be hidden.

notes.title: A new release is here! Clip names, Track names and Smooth Locomotion.
notes.content:
[h1]v0.0.0.18 is here![/h1]

[b]Clip names[/b] and [b]Track names[/b] can now be displayed in AliveInVR in Session mode. It's a selectable option in the menu. They appear when you're close enough to read them clearly.

In addition, [b]walking mode[/b] has been added as a selectable feature in the menu. 

This allows [b]smooth locomotion[/b] using the left pad on Vive (and left thumbstick on the Oculus Rift). With the right pad/right thumbstick controlling rotation when clicked left or right. This means you can now go anywhere in the Scene - set your mix playing and run into the Sea!


The menu system layout has also been updated.
